objective: Freeze person/episode identity, relationship cardinality, lifecycle separation, deterministic stream and checkpoint oracles for A5.2–A5.3; do not claim runtime implementation in this contract packet.
steps: Define typed longitudinal and episode identity namespaces, cardinality, uniqueness and readmission semantics.
Define typed relationship edges and cycle rules separately from entity and episode destruction/lifecycle.
Specify deterministic creation/idempotency, birth multiplicity, event accounting, RNG namespace and checkpoint/replay cases.
Validate the packet and case matrix, inspect the diff, and obtain reviewer-agent contract review on the exact commit.
Specify canonical logical-event ordering and conflict arbitration independent of arrival, traversal and worker order; add permutation oracle.
Specify sealed-time late identity event behavior and add atomic rejection/dedupe/RNG oracle.

acceptance: ADR-0014 resolves identity and lifecycle cases for readmission, concurrent episodes, recycled handles, relationship cycles, duplicate spawn, birth multiplicity, deterministic streams and checkpoint/replay.
Relationship removal and episode closure do not implicitly destroy a person or dependent; death is explicit and history remains addressable.
The case matrix is a specification oracle, not a runtime test pass; no Rust source, ED schema, Kairos source or parent pin changes.
Reviewer-agent/subagent checks the exact commit against CC-01/CC-07, A5.1 and ADR-0012; findings are fixed and re-reviewed before coordinator acceptance.
Competing identity commands resolve in canonical logical order and the case matrix compares accepted/rejected IDs, complete state and RNG under order permutations.
Late identity events after a sealed logical time reject atomically without consuming IDs or RNG; checkpoint replay is separate and explicit.
